hints.title: Component Partitioning
hints.text: Removing any vertex partitions the tree into the subtrees of its children plus the remaining component above it.

hints.title: Subtree Size Calculation
hints.text: Compute the subtree size rooted at each node using post-order tree traversal.

hints.title: Score Computation
hints.text: The score of a node is the product of the sizes of its disconnected non-empty components.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.space: O(N) subtree sizes and call stack
variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Removal of a node divides the tree into child subtrees and an upper component.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing connected components for each node independently takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: One bottom-up traversal precomputes all subtree sizes for O(1) score evaluation per node.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute the upper component size as n - subtree_size[u].
